about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce paměťových čipů (DRAM, flash) a SSD disků.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí iPhony, Macy, iPady a další elektroniku a prodává k nim software a služby.

about.label: Lam Research
about.summary: American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and related services to the semiconductor industry.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro výrobu čipů, hlavně pro leptání a nanášení vrstev.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává platformy pro analýzu dat a umělou inteligenci vládám, armádám i firmám.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Arista Networks
about.summary: American provider of client to cloud networking services for large data center/AI, campus and routing environments.
about.summary_cs: Americký dodavatel síťových technologií pro velká datová centra, AI a firemní sítě.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí síťová zařízení, například routery a switche, a software pro sítě a bezpečnost.

about.label: Fortinet
about.summary: American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products including firewalls, endpoint security and intrusion detection systems.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a další ochranu sítí a zařízení.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Oracle Corporation
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Austin, Texas. Co-founded in Santa Clara, California, in 1977 by Bob Miner, Ed Oates, and current chairman of the board and chief technology officer Larry Ellison, Oracle is among the 50 largest companies in the world by market cap, and ranked 52nd on the Forbes Global 2000 as of 2026.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává databáze, podnikový software a cloudové služby.

about.label: Intel
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs, manufactures, and sells computer components such as central processing units and related products for business and consumer markets.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce procesorů pro počítače a servery, který vyrábí čipy i na zakázku.

about.label: Applied Materials
about.summary: American corporation that supplies equipment, services and software for the manufacture of semiconductor chips for electronics, flat panel displays for computers, smartphones, televisions, and solar products.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává zařízení, služby a software pro výrobu čipů, displejů a solárních panelů.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která chrání počítače a servery, sleduje hrozby a pomáhá řešit kybernetické útoky.

about.label: Marvell Technology
about.summary: American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro datová centra, sítě a ukládání dat.

about.label: Intercontinental Exchange
about.summary: American multinational financial services company that operates global financial exchanges, including stock exchanges and futures exchanges, as well as clearing houses, and provides technology and services for mortgage loan origination, closing, and servicing.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje burzy (včetně Newyorské burzy) a zúčtovací centra a dodává technologie pro hypotéky.

about.label: Moody's Corporation
about.summary: American business and financial services company.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která uděluje úvěrové ratingy firmám a státům a dodává finanční data a analýzy.

about.label: Boeing
about.summary: American multinational corporation that designs and manufactures airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and missiles worldwide.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce dopravních letadel, vojenské techniky a kosmických systémů.

about.label: Western Digital
about.summary: American data storage company headquartered in San Jose, California. Established in 1970, the company is one of the world's largest manufacturers of hard disk drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: KLA Corporation
about.summary: American company based in Milpitas, California that makes wafer fab equipment.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro kontrolu a měření čipů při jejich výrobě.

about.label: ServiceNow
about.summary: American software company that supplies cloud computing platforms for the creation and management of automated business workflows.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, jejíž cloudová platforma automatizuje firemní procesy, třeba IT podporu nebo personalistiku.

about.label: Seagate Technology
about.summary: Irish-domiciled data storage company. Since 2010, the company has been incorporated in Dublin, Ireland, with operational headquarters in Fremont, California, United States.
about.summary_cs: Americko-irský výrobce pevných disků a úložišť dat.

about.label: Uber
about.summary: American multinational transportation company that provides ride-hailing services, courier services, food delivery, and freight transport.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje aplikaci pro objednání odvozu, rozvoz jídla a doručování.

about.label: Cloudflare
about.summary: American technology company headquartered in San Francisco, California, that provides a range of internet services, including content delivery network services, cloud cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and ICANN-accredited domain registration. about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která zrychluje a chrání weby a online služby.

about.label: NetApp
about.summary: American data infrastructure company that provides unified data storage, integrated data services, and cloud operations solutions to enterprise customers.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává úložiště dat a software pro správu dat v datových centrech a cloudu.

about.summary: American technology company that provides safety and security products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí radiostanice, kamerové systémy a software pro policii, hasiče a záchranáře.

about.label: Teradyne
about.summary: American automatic test equipment designer and manufacturer based in North Reading, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce zařízení pro automatické testování čipů a průmyslových robotů.

about.label: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
about.summary: American multinational information technology company based in Spring, Texas. It is a business-focused organization which works in servers, storage, networking, AI, containerization software and consulting and support.
about.summary_cs: Americká IT firma pro podniky, která dodává servery, úložiště, sítě a cloudové a AI služby.

about.label: Dell Technologies
about.summary: American multinational technology company that has been headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, since 1994. Dell Technologies ranked 44th on the 2025 Fortune 500 rankings of the largest United States corporations based on its 2024 revenue; its products include personal computers, servers, monitors, computer software, computer security and network security, as we
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí osobní počítače, servery, monitory a nabízí software a zabezpečení.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.summary: American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro mobily a bezdrátovou komunikaci a licencuje své patenty.
